intro: Everything above is the Lakeville kitchen and the Lakeville bar. Stillwater is a different arrangement: the bays sit inside Stillwater Bowl & Lounge, and the food and drink are theirs — burgers, bites and a full bar, ordered and paid for on their side of the building. One visit, one evening, two businesses.

gaps.label: The Stillwater menu
gaps.reason: It is not ours to publish. Whether Stillwater Bowl & Lounge’s menu gets reproduced here, linked to, or left with them has not been settled with either business — and reprinting somebody else’s prices without asking is how a page ends up wrong on the night.
